cards.front: Explain the doctrines of severability and eclipse as applied to laws that violate Fundamental Rights. To which laws does the doctrine of eclipse apply?
cards.back:
DoctrineMeaningCase
SeverabilityOnly the part of a law that violates an FR is void; the rest survives if it can stand on its ownState of Bombay v. F.N. Balsara (1951)
EclipseA pre-Constitution law that violates an FR is not dead but dormant; it revives if the FR is amended to remove the conflictBhikaji Narain Dhakras (1955)

Eclipse applies only to pre-Constitution laws. A post-Constitution law that violates an FR is void from the start (Deep Chand, 1959) and does not revive.
